text_block_list.text:
A match race against Mejiro McQueen—over 2,400 meters on turf.
The trial that would decide my fate as a trainer was underway.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(In the early stages... she seems to be keeping up somehow.
However, 2,400 meters is a long stretch. The real challenge begins now.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Approaching the final stretch! The showdown starts he—wait, what?!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahhhhhhhhhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (What? Spurring into a final kick already?! She overtook me...?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Impressive speed. —However!
Haaahhhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Naive... How naive. Did you truly believe you could sustain such a burst
all the way to the wire? This is as far as you go, Satono-san!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Khhh, guuuuaaaahhh!

—Though she edged ahead for a fleeting moment, she was thoroughly outpaced thereafter,
leaving Satono Diamond defeated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono-san, what in the world was that?...
Would the two of you care to explain?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant...*

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(She's... not looking at me?
Even when I call out to her, not at all. And what's more...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(There is no regret... in her eyes...
Does that look mean... she gave it everything she had?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (I see. So that's what it was.)

text_block_list.name: Diamond's Father
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us move on to the evaluation. A gap opened up
at the very end, but... I would like to hear McQueen-san's opinion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Before I share the results, allow me to explain, you two.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You were not aiming for "victory," were you?
Nor did you tailor her training specifically for 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Neither victory nor specialization...?
Whatever do you mean by that—?

As expected of Mejiro McQueen. It seems you saw
straight through Satono Diamond's run to the truth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Shall I explain to the both of you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Understood, McQueen-san.
We will...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh, reduce my training volume? Not only that,
you're saying passing the trial isn't a priority...? Trainer, what is the meaning of this?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If we don't pass, they will never accept us as a pair!
And yet—!
choice_data_list: The most important thing is "making your dream come true."
The most important thing is "making your dream come true."

text_block_list.text: Specifically, "winning a GⅠ in the future." While her body is still developing, conditioning her specifically for a 2,400m race carries far too much risk.
Looking at the upcoming Junior year, GⅠ races only go up to 2,000m. Throwing that away to pour everything into this trial is a choice I cannot make as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying... we should hold back?
Just to protect me...? But, that's...
choice_data_list: No! There are things we must do right now!
No! There are things we have to do right now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The single most important thing for the two of us... is making our dream come true.
Not today's trial.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is why we have devoted ourselves purely to "what is necessary right now."
Even if this is not to your liking...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is the path we must take. And—we will fulfill my dream and the family's long-cherished wish without fail. That is why we found each other, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A "speed" that holds up in a 2,000m GⅠ. While we cannot demonstrate the comprehensive strength to win a 2,400m race today, this speed will lead to our future GⅠ victories.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This is what we truly wanted to show you! This is our stepping stone toward our dream.
It is the absolute maximum we can show you today!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Dia... You...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That makes everything clear now. That push before the final stretch—it was far too early for this race because it was meant for the final stretch of a 2,000m...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And the look in Satono-san's eyes when she was defeated...
It was just like mine, once upon a time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It was during my Classic season.
Back when everyone was burning with fleeting dreams, competing with one another...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Everyone was fiercely aiming for the Triple Crown... But I decided not to make the Triple Crown my top priority, choosing instead to aim for the Tenno Sho (Spring), which the Mejiro family holds most dear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is a path one must walk, even if it means sacrificing one's once-in-a-lifetime youth...
Which is precisely why, standing here today—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The only ones who ever grasp their cherished dreams... are those prepared to pursue them single-mindedly, even if it means throwing everything else away.
Mejiro McQueen looked over at us with a maternal, gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
I see... I understand now...
I see... So that's why...

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Perhaps we were the ones who failed to commit fully to the dream. We focused so much on our foundations, on being respectable nobility, that we failed to claim a GⅠ victory.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: If that is the case, something must change. And if our daughter, who has broken jinx after jinx, sensed something in this...
Satono Diamond's father exchanged a glance with her mother, nodded slowly, and—

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Please take good care of Dia from here on out.
She is our family's finest, most precious rough diamond—

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
And—we wish to entrust our beloved daughter to you.
Let us place our faith in the bond you two share.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Waaahh! Trainer, we did it!
We really did it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's make our dream come true! Together, the two of us will break the greatest jinx that no one else could! With our combined strength!
And so, we somehow managed to overcome the Satono family's trial and earned their approval as a Trainer-trainee pair. But—
Our journey is still only just beginning. We will carry the Satono family's long-cherished wish—to win a GⅠ and shine at the pinnacle—as our shared dream, and march forward.
